title: Prove fixed-word P104 hub-gauge invariance of PURE capacity (no new κ)
body:
Resolve the interior-pair question left by #6835 under a fixed middle event word, matched cuts, fixed read rules and a complete helper block. Boundary bases are unrestricted within the stated dyadic class. Every endpoint solution differs by one invertible dyadic gauge B on H=K∩R, with inverse output gauge. Contragredient transport preserves the entire PURE Gram matrix in transported bases, every Smith factor and unit-pair capacity, not merely rational rank. The earlier #5599 sufficient split witnesses also transport when private resets make the state rectangular.

New relative to #6835's endpoint existence theorem and #6827's PURE criterion: the complete stabilizer and cut-pairing isomorphism. A same-total-matrix, same-seven-MOVE example changes cut capacity after intermediate mixing, proving why the fixed-word premise is essential.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6835: 44316f3e6023a7f8c516360e22e9efd6f0fe48c5.
#6827: f0fbfd64ea8e7396a6e324d9103350b67215d890.
#6824 native: 2a7ca44fbda3abaa4df355b183ed7d7478eef7c1.
The #5599 proof is retained from the exact base, not represented as its original PR head. All input blob/SHA256 pins are included.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-hub-gauge-invariance
```
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: normal/-O exact checks and separate proof/code review. Native applicability checks cover the nontrivial 359-helper gauge, all 77 complete classes and all 801 state rows at three cuts. Controls distinguish rank from dyadic capacity, column-only and restricted-label failures, the same-total-matrix escape, and nonzero owned resets. Committed bytes/modes, export integrity and both fresh Git-free exported replays pass. Complete remote tree matches the tested package.

No new κ. This excludes gauge-only improvement of intrinsic PURE capacity for the fixed word. Changed middle operations, routes, helper boundaries and cheaper basis implementations remain open. No full native PURE census or new completion algorithm is claimed. All five framework assumptions remain; complete selected/compiler/precision/analytic replay was not run.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate AI-agent mathematical reviews; no human or proof-kernel acceptance. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6835/#6827/#6824), Ali Romman (#5599) and retained native lineage. Apache-2.0.
